literal: Character and lineage and faults and undiminished kindred and, having known, make friendship.
translation: Make friends only after examining a person's character, lineage, faults, and their unfailing kindred.
modern: ஒருவருடைய குணம், குடும்பப் பின்னணி, குறைகள் மற்றும் குறையாத சுற்றத்தார் ஆகியவற்றை நன்கு ஆராய்ந்து அறிந்த பிறகே அவரிடம் நட்பு கொள்ள வேண்டும்.
explanation: This couplet lists the essential qualities to investigate before forming a friendship. One must carefully examine a potential friend's good character, family background, personal flaws, and the nature of their constant companions. The word 'அறிந்தியாக்க' emphasizes that friendship should be bound or forged only after thoroughly knowing all these aspects. By weighing both the good and the bad, one ensures a stable and trustworthy relationship.
